entries.source: Gustav Pfeifer, Die Liechtensteiner. Ein Beitrag zur Geschichte der Ministerialität des Hochstiftes Trient im 12. und 13. Jahrhundert, Geschichte und Region / Storia e regione 4 (1995), p. 177 n. 88; Pfeifer p. 177 n. 88, quoting Voltelini/Huter, Notariatsimbreviaturen, no. 126a, dated 5 April 1242
entries.latin: Fr(iderici) et H(ainrici) et R(einhardi) fratrum de Rosenbach
entries.english: A notarial instrument drawn up in Bolzano lists Wilhelm of Liechtenstein and three Rosenbach brothers—Friedrich, Heinrich and Reinhard—among the persons present. Their relationship as brothers is explicitly stated in the witness formula. The surrounding transaction is not established by the quoted passage alone.

facts.subject: Friedrich de Rosenbach, Heinrich de Rosenbach, and Reinhard de Rosenbach
